content: मूर्च्छन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) .²1 Stupefying, producing insensibility or stupor (an epithet applied to one of the five arrows of Cupid). .²2 Increasing, augmenting, strengthening. .{@-नम्, -ना@} [मुर्च्छ्-युच्] .²1 Fainting, swooning. .²2 Prevalence, growth, increase (usually {%n.%} in this sense); अनुकर्षं च निष्कर्षं व्याधिपावकमूर्च्छनम् <ls>Mb. 2. 13. 13</ls>. .²3 A process in metallic preparation, calcining quicksilver with sulphur; <ab>cf.</ab> मूर्च्छा (3) also. .²4 (In music) The rising of sounds, an intonation, a duly regulated rise and fall of sounds conducting the air and the harmony through the keys in a pleasing manner, changing the key or passing from the key to another; modulation, melody; स्फुटीभवद्ग्रामविशेषमूर्च्छनाम् <ls>Śi. 1. 10</ls>; भूयो भूयः स्वयमपि कृतां मूर्च्छनां विस्मरन्ती <ls>Me. 88</ls>; वर्णानामपि मूर्च्छनान्तरगतं तारं विरामे मृदु <ls>Mk. 3. 5</ls>; सप्त स्वरास्त्रयो ग्रामा मूर्च्छनाश्चैकविंशतिः <ls>Pt. 5. 54</ls>; (मूर्च्छा or मूर्च्छना is thus defined:-- क्रमात् स्वराणां सप्तानामारोहश्चावरोहणम् . सा मूर्च्छेत्युच्यते ग्रामस्था एताः सप्त सप्त च .. see <ls>Malli.</ls> on <ls>Śi. 1. 10</ls> for further information); ‘यत्रैव स्युः स्वराः पूर्णा मूर्च्छना सेत्युदाहृता’ <ab>com.</ab> on <ls>Rām. 1. 4. 10</ls>.
